entities.name: Sinclair
entities.control_summary: Dual-class. The Smith brothers hold about 81% of voting power (80.6% as of May 2026 13D). ~179 stations in 81 markets.
entities.notes: Local TV group. Not a newspaper chain.

entities.name: Sinclair Smith family
entities.control_summary: David, Frederick, J. Duncan, and Robert Smith. Class B carries 10 votes. Combined ~80.6% voting power.
entities.notes: Unrelated to the Comcast Roberts family or A. O. Smith.

entities.name: Sinclair local stations
entities.control_summary: Group node for Sinclair-operated or serviced local TV newsrooms. Voting control sits with the Sinclair Smith family.
entities.notes: 179 stations / 81 markets as of early 2026. Not every call sign is listed.

entities.name: WJLA (ABC 7 Washington)
entities.control_summary: Sinclair's Washington, D.C. ABC affiliate. Same Smith-family voting control as the rest of the group.

entities.name: Nexstar
entities.control_summary: Largest U.S. local TV group by station count. One-share-one-vote. No family dual-class lock. Owns NewsNation, The Hill, and a controlling stake in The CW.
entities.notes: 201 owned or partner stations in 116 markets.

entities.name: Nexstar local stations
entities.control_summary: Group node for Nexstar local newsrooms. Public parent, no dual-class controller.

entities.name: NewsNation
entities.control_summary: Nexstar national cable news. No family controller at the parent.

entities.name: The Hill
entities.control_summary: Bought by Nexstar in 2021. Same public parent as NewsNation and the local station group.

entities.name: Hearst
entities.control_summary: Private. Hearst family. Newspapers, local TV, magazines, and a 20% stake in ESPN (Disney operates ESPN).

entities.name: Hearst family
entities.control_summary: Beneficial owners of Hearst. No public float.

entities.name: Hearst Television
entities.control_summary: Hearst's local TV group. Private family control.
entities.notes: Group node — individual call signs not enumerated.

entities.name: Houston Chronicle
entities.control_summary: Hearst newspaper. Private family control.

entities.name: San Francisco Chronicle
entities.control_summary: Hearst newspaper. Private family control.

entities.name: Alden Global Capital
entities.control_summary: Private hedge fund. Randall D. Smith founded; Heath Freeman is president. Second-largest U.S. newspaper owner after Gannett.
entities.notes: Owns MediaNews Group / Digital First Media and Tribune Publishing.

entities.name: MediaNews Group
entities.control_summary: Alden's newspaper operating company (also trades as Digital First Media).

entities.name: Tribune Publishing
entities.control_summary: Bought by Alden in 2021. Chicago Tribune, Baltimore Sun era titles; Daily News later held in an Alden affiliate.

entities.name: The Denver Post
entities.control_summary: MediaNews Group / Alden.

entities.name: Chicago Tribune
entities.control_summary: Tribune Publishing / Alden.

entities.name: New York Daily News
entities.control_summary: Alden affiliate after the Tribune acquisition.

entities.name: The Mercury News
entities.control_summary: MediaNews Group / Alden.

entities.name: Heath Freeman
entities.control_summary: President of Alden Global Capital. Public face of the newspaper group.

entities.name: Randall D. Smith
entities.control_summary: Founder of Alden Global Capital.
entities.notes: Unrelated to the Sinclair Smith brothers.

entities.name: Advance Publications
entities.control_summary: Newhouse family. Local papers, Condé Nast, and other holdings.

entities.name: Newhouse family
entities.control_summary: Beneficial owners of Advance Publications.

entities.name: The New Yorker
entities.control_summary: Condé Nast / Advance / Newhouse family.

entities.name: Condé Nast
entities.control_summary: Advance magazine division.

entities.name: Reuters
entities.control_summary: Thomson Reuters. Voting control sits with the Thomson family through Woodbridge.

entities.name: Thomson Reuters
entities.control_summary: Public float exists. The Thomson family, via Woodbridge, holds a controlling voting interest.

entities.name: Thomson family
entities.control_summary: Controls Thomson Reuters through Woodbridge. Reuters is an operating title, not a widely held newsroom.

entities.name: Associated Press
entities.control_summary: Not-for-profit news cooperative owned by its member newspapers and broadcasters. No residual shareholders.

entities.name: The Atlantic
entities.control_summary: Emerson Collective. Laurene Powell Jobs is the controlling owner.

entities.name: Emerson Collective
entities.control_summary: Laurene Powell Jobs's holding company.

entities.name: Laurene Powell Jobs
entities.control_summary: Controls Emerson Collective, owner of The Atlantic.

entities.name: Detroit Free Press
entities.control_summary: Gannett. Same 1-share-1-vote parent as USA Today.

entities.name: The Arizona Republic
entities.control_summary: Gannett. Same 1-share-1-vote parent as USA Today.

entities.name: David D. Smith
entities.control_summary: Executive chairman of Sinclair. Largest individual slice of the family Class B block.
